templates.template:
<xf:if is="$xf.options.cinvinHome_BoardDescription"> <xf:set var="$homeDescription" value="{$xf.options.cinvinHome_BoardDescription}" /> <xf:else /> <xf:set var="$homeDescription" value="{$xf.options.boardDescription}" /> </xf:if> <xf:macro template="metadata_macros" name="metadata" arg-description="{$homeDescription}" arg-shareUrl="{$xf.options.boardUrl}" arg-canonicalUrl="{$xf.options.boardUrl}" />
<xf:if is="!$xf.options.cinvinHome_DisplayBreadcrumbs"> <xf:css> .p-breadcrumbs { display: none; } </xf:css> </xf:if>
<xf:if is="$xf.options.cinvinHome_DisplayBoardTitle"> <xf:h1>{$xf.options.boardTitle}</xf:h1> <xf:else /> <xf:h1 hidden="true" /> </xf:if>
<xf:if is="$xf.options.cinvinHome_DisplayBoardDescription"> <xf:description>{$homeDescription}</xf:description> </xf:if>
<xf:pageaction> <xf:if is="$xf.options.cinvinHome_DisplayButtonNewPosts "> <xf:button href="{{ $xf.options.forumsDefaultPage == 'new_posts' ? link('forums/new-posts') : link('whats-new/posts') }}" icon="bolt"> {{ phrase('new_posts') }} </xf:button> </xf:if> <xf:if is="$xf.options.cinvinHome_DisplayButtonPostThread"> <xf:if is="$xf.visitor.canCreateThread()"> <xf:button href="{{ link('forums/create-thread') }}" class="button--cta" icon="write" overlay="true"> {{ phrase('post_thread...') }} </xf:button> </xf:if> </xf:if> </xf:pageaction>
<xf:widgetpos id="cinvin_home_sidebar" position="sidebar" />
<xf:ad position="cinvin_home_above" /> <xf:widgetpos id="cinvin_home_content_above" /> <xf:ad position="cinvin_home_content_above" /> <xf:widgetpos id="cinvin_home_content" /> <xf:ad position="cinvin_home_content_below" /> <xf:widgetpos id="cinvin_home_content_below" /> <xf:ad position="cinvin_home_below" />
